import asyncio,sys,os
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/telegram-robot-leads/scripts')
from telethon_sessions import inspect,make_memory_client
from telethon.tl.functions.channels import GetParticipantRequest
from telethon.tl.types import ChannelParticipantAdmin,ChannelParticipantCreator
config=inspect(__import__('pathlib').Path('/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads'))
async def check(entry):
 client=make_memory_client(entry,config)
 number=entry['index']
 try:
  await asyncio.wait_for(client.connect(),25)
  auth=await asyncio.wait_for(client.is_user_authorized(),20)
  if not auth:
   print('GROUP_PRIVILEGES',number,'authorized',False);return False
  group=await asyncio.wait_for(client.get_entity(config['group']),25)
  me=await asyncio.wait_for(client.get_me(),20)
  obj=await asyncio.wait_for(client(GetParticipantRequest(channel=group,participant=me)),25)
  participant=obj.participant
  role=type(participant).__name__
  admin=isinstance(participant,(ChannelParticipantAdmin,ChannelParticipantCreator))
  rights=getattr(participant,'admin_rights',None)
  print('GROUP_PRIVILEGES',number,'authorized',True,'group_access',True,'role',role,'admin_or_owner',admin,'invite_users',bool(getattr(rights,'invite_users',False)) if rights else admin)
  return True
 except Exception as exc:
  print('GROUP_PRIVILEGES',number,'status','UNVERIFIED','error_type',type(exc).__name__);return False
 finally:
  if client.is_connected():
   await client.disconnect()
async def main():
 statuses=[]
 for row in config['entries']:statuses.append(await check(row))
 print('GROUP_ACCESS_READONLY_FINISHED',statuses)
asyncio.run(main())
